discourse.title: God Has No Form
discourse.excerpt: God is giving you so much. You are getting free education, free medical aid, and free water. He is talking with you so freely and moving about amongst you so freely. He is giving you everything so 'free'! How do you express your gratitude for all these? You must give up your ego and spread happiness like He does. That will be the right thing to do.
discourse.theme: Gratitude to God: give up ego and spread happiness.

reflection: God gives you everything for free, Swami says — education, health, water, even His own company. And what do you give back? The question should stop you short. His answer is beautiful: give up your ego, and spread happiness the way He does. That's it. That's gratitude. Today, thank one person who has helped you, and carry someone's burden a little way. (Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 35, 23 May 2002)

video.title: Should we not be grateful to nature for everything? | Sri Sathya Sai Speaks | Feb 27, 1995

seva_nudge: Write down three things you're grateful for, and personally thank one person who helped you this week.
